path: StarterPlayerScripts/JuiceFx.client.luau
purpose: Feature: Juice and polish pass using the prebuilt ReplicatedStorage/GameAssets kit (require it; do not rewrite it): call GameAssets.styleLighting() once on the server so the world has warm sky lighting, bloom and atmosphere. On the client, a new JuiceFx script listens to the existing remotes and plays: upgrade purchased -> GameAssets.play('Buy') + GameAssets.burst at the pad + GameAssets.shake(0.3, 0.2) + a Toast 'Unlocked: <name>!'; not enough cash -> GameAssets.play('Error') + Toast 'Need $X more'; ore tier upgrade -> GameAssets.play('Win') + a big RewardPopup 'GOLD ORE! $N per cube' + medium shake; rebirth -> GameAssets.play('Boom') then 'Win', large shake and a white flash. The HUD shows income per second ('+$12/s', computed on the client from the last 5 seconds of cash gains) under the cash counter and a 'Next goal' bar that fills toward the cheapest unbought upgrade's cost. Server side, newly unlocked droppers rise in with GameAssets.popIn. Bump counters juice_events and income_shown. -- Client-only script. It WaitForChilds 'JuiceFx' and 'JuiceAck' with timeouts and requires GameAssets. On kind 'buy' it plays GameAssets.play('Buy'), GameAssets.burst at the pad position, GameAssets.shake(0.3,0.2) and shows the toast 'Unlocked: <name>!'. On 'poor' it plays play('Error') and the toast 'Need $X more' using NumberFormat. On 'ore' it plays play('Win'), shows a big RewardPopup 'GOLD ORE! $N per cube' and a medium shake. On 'rebirth' it plays play('Boom'), then play('Win') after a short delay, a large shake and a white full-screen flash that tweens out. It also builds its own ScreenGui under the Hud cash counter, styled with UiTheme. The income label shows '+$N/s', computed from a rolling 5-second window of positive Cash leaderstat gains (sampled on Cash.Changed, pruned each second). The 'Next goal' bar fills as Cash divided by the cost from the latest 'goal' event, with a label for the goal name and cost. It fires JuiceAck('income') once the income label is first shown, then at most every 5s. It does not duplicate existing toast systems: it uses a GameAssets toast helper if one exists, otherwise its own small label. Bump ForgeTelemetry counters: juice_events, income_shown.
depends: ReplicatedStorage/GameAssets.luau, ReplicatedStorage/NumberFormat.luau, ReplicatedStorage/UiTheme.luau

### ReplicatedStorage/NumberFormat.luau
```luau
--!strict
-- NumberFormat: pure shared helpers for compact number display (no services, no side effects).

local NumberFormat = {}

-- Ascending list of units.
local UNITS: { { any } } = {
	{ 1e3, "K" },
	{ 1e6, "M" },
	{ 1e9, "B" },
	{ 1e12, "T" },
}

local function roundTenth(x: number): number
	return math.floor(x * 10 + 0.5) / 10
end

local function trim(v: number): string
	local s = string.format("%.1f", v)
	s = s:gsub("%.0$", "")
	return s
end

-- 999 -> "999", 1234 -> "1.2K", 999950 -> "1M", 3400000 -> "3.4M"
function NumberFormat.short(n: any): string
	if type(n) ~= "number" or n ~= n then
		return "0"
	end
	local num: number = n
	if num == math.huge then
		return "∞"
	elseif num == -math.huge then
		return "-∞"
	end
	local neg = num < 0
	local a = math.abs(num)
	local sign = if neg then "-" else ""

	if a < 1000 then
		local r = math.floor(a + 0.5)
		if r < 1000 then
			if r == 0 then
				return "0"
			end
			return sign .. tostring(r)
		end
		a = 1000 -- 999.5+ rounds up into the K range
	end

	local idx = 1
	for i = 1, #UNITS do
		if a >= (UNITS[i][1] :: number) then
			idx = i
		end
	end

	local v = roundTenth(a / (UNITS[idx][1] :: number))
	if v >= 1000 and idx < #UNITS then
		idx += 1
		v = roundTenth(a / (UNITS[idx][1] :: number))
	end
	return sign .. trim(v) .. (UNITS[idx][2] :: string)
end

-- 1234567 -> "1,234,567"
function NumberFormat.withCommas(n: any): string
	if type(n) ~= "number" or n ~= n or n == math.huge or n == -math.huge then
		return "0"
	end
	local num: number = n
	local neg = num < 0
	local s = string.format("%.0f", math.abs(num))
	local out = s
	while true do
		local replaced, count = out:gsub("^(%d+)(%d%d%d)", "%1,%2")
		out = replaced
		if count == 0 then
			break
		end
	end
	if out == "0" then
		return "0"
	end
	return (if neg then "-" else "") .. out
end

return NumberFormat
```

## Lessons from past builds
# Lessons
## Design
- Tune early progression so a playtest of roughly 15 seconds can reach the first purchase or milestone. Use a fast starting income or a cheap first upgrade (a few seconds of income). Slow openings leave the buy loop untested and feel dull.
- Give per-event feedback for every economy action: a "+N" popup on collect, plus HUD hints for upgrade cost, affordability or progress. Without it, numbers going up feels weak between purchases.
- Place trigger pads (buy pads, claim gates, etc.) off the spawn path so walking from spawn never fires them accidentally.
- Make moving cubes or other spawned items non-colliding with players (CanCollide = false, or a collision group) and cap their count per area. Otherwise they jitter, stick or knock players around.

## Luau and Roblox APIs
- The base place is empty: build the map from code (Instance.new Parts, Anchored = true, parented to Workspace).
- Get services with game:GetService("Players") etc.; use task.wait / task.spawn / task.delay, never wait / spawn / delay.
- Players.PlayerAdded can fire before your script connects in a playtest: also loop over Players:GetPlayers() once at startup.
- Wait for characters with player.CharacterAdded (and player.Character if already present); use WaitForChild with a timeout across the client/server boundary.
- ModuleScripts must return exactly one value (usually a table); require them by path, e.g. require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Config")).
- Create RemoteEvents on the server in one place; clients only WaitForChild them and handle nil after the timeout.
- Bump counters for key gameplay events with require(ReplicatedStorage.ForgeTelemetry).count("name", 1) (server only) so playtests can verify the core loop. Include counters for purchases and other branches that need verification.
- Count each telemetry counter in exactly one place (the module that owns the event). Duplicate count calls push once-only counters past their expected value.
- Touched fires many times per touch: debounce per player (a per-player cooldown or a one-time purchased flag) and check and deduct cost in the same step to prevent double-buys or double-spends.
- Define the data shape that a builder module returns (field names such as origin, gate, spawn) once, and have consumers use those exact fields. Do not add `a or b` fallbacks for guessed names.

## Fixing and debugging
- A "sync" StudioError about not being able to serve a path is an infrastructure or environment failure, not a code bug. Do not change game code in response. Retry the step.
- If the critic says a code path was never exercised in the playtest, fix the pacing or setup so the path actually runs (e.g. cheaper first purchase) instead of only adding more code.
- When the spec changes the flow (e.g. from auto-assign to claim), rewrite the entry script (Game.server) to require and wire the new modules, and delete the old flow's logic (slots, teleport on join). Updating only the new modules leaves the old behaviour running.
- After a redesign, check that every module is required by the entry script and that its init function is called. Unwired modules never run, and their counters never fire.

## UI kit (house style for all UI: paste the snippets you use, Theme first, and adapt; plain Luau, not modules)
- Chunky text: every label gets a dark UIStroke (2.5-4 px). LuckiestGuy for titles/numbers, FredokaOne for body. Never default or thin fonts.
- One palette everywhere: yellow Primary = main action, green Good = affordable/claim, red Bad = close/can't, blue Info = secondary, dark Ink outlines.
- Depth: UICorner 12-18 px, UIStroke border, light-top UIGradient fill, hard drop shadow 4-6 px below.
- Everything moves: appear with a Back-eased UIScale pop (0 -> 1), react with a punch (1.2 -> 1), press squish to 0.9. Tween UIScale, not Size; 0.1-0.4 s, never linear.
- Numbers tick up and pop on change, big values short ("12.5K"); gains flash green, losses red.
- Every action gives feedback: toast, floating "+N" or reward popup. Max 3 toasts.
- Mobile first: 1280x720 offsets under a viewport UIScale (`Theme.screen`), safe insets, buttons >= 44 px, nothing key in the top-left (Roblox menu).
- HUD hugs the edges, centre stays clear; windows open over a dim backdrop with a close X.
- World prices on BillboardGuis: green when affordable, red when not.
- UI is built in code with Instance.new, no image asset ids (emoji/letters for icons), ResetOnSpawn = false.

### Theme.luau (Always first in a UI file: palette, fonts, corner/stroke/gradient/shadow/tween/pop/punch helpers, Theme.screen() for a ScreenGui that scales on phones.)
```luau
-- Theme: palette, fonts and style helpers every other UI kit snippet uses. Paste it first, once per LocalScript.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local Theme = {
	Ink = Color3.fromRGB(28, 22, 38), Cream = Color3.fromRGB(255, 248, 232),
	Primary = Color3.fromRGB(255, 196, 41), Good = Color3.fromRGB(88, 214, 92),
	Bad = Color3.fromRGB(240, 68, 64), Info = Color3.fromRGB(64, 170, 255), Gem = Color3.fromRGB(190, 92, 255),
	Header = Enum.Font.LuckiestGuy, Body = Enum.Font.FredokaOne, Stroke = 3, Radius = 12,
}

function Theme.corner(gui: GuiObject, r: number?)
	local c = Instance.new("UICorner")
	c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, r or Theme.Radius)
	c.Parent = gui
end

-- border=true outlines the box; default outlines the text glyphs (the chunky game look).
function Theme.stroke(gui: GuiObject, px: number?, color: Color3?, border: boolean?): UIStroke
	local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	s.Thickness = px or Theme.Stroke
	s.Color = color or Theme.Ink
	s.ApplyStrokeMode = if border then Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border else Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Contextual
	s.Parent = gui
	return s
end

function Theme.gradient(gui: GuiObject, base: Color3)
	local g = Instance.new("UIGradient")
	g.Rotation = 90
	g.Color = ColorSequence.new(base:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.35), base:Lerp(Color3.new(), 0.12))
	g.Parent = gui
end

-- Hard drop shadow behind gui (same parent, ZIndex - 1). Call after gui is parented.
function Theme.shadow(gui: GuiObject, px: number?): Frame
	local sh = Instance.new("Frame")
	sh.AnchorPoint, sh.Size = gui.AnchorPoint, gui.Size
	sh.Position = gui.Position + UDim2.fromOffset(0, px or 5)
	sh.BackgroundColor3, sh.BackgroundTransparency, sh.BorderSizePixel = Theme.Ink, 0.4, 0
	sh.ZIndex = gui.ZIndex - 1
	Theme.corner(sh)
	sh.Parent = gui.Parent
	return sh
end

function Theme.tween(inst: Instance, t: number, props: { [string]: any }, style: Enum.EasingStyle?): Tween
	local tw = TweenService:Create(inst, TweenInfo.new(t, style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), props)
	tw:Play()
	return tw
end

local function juiceScale(gui: GuiObject): UIScale
	local s = gui:FindFirstChild("Juice") or Instance.new("UIScale")
	s.Name, s.Parent = "Juice", gui
	return s :: UIScale
end

function Theme.pop(gui: GuiObject, t: number?) -- appear: scale 0 -> 1 with Back overshoot
	local s = juiceScale(gui)
	s.Scale = 0
	Theme.tween(s, t or 0.3, { Scale = 1 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
end

function Theme.punch(gui: GuiObject, amount: number?) -- react: 1.2 -> 1
	local s = juiceScale(gui)
	s.Scale = 1 + (amount or 0.2)
	Theme.tween(s, 0.25, { Scale = 1 }, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
end

-- Design in 1280x720 offsets; the UIScale fits it to any screen, safe insets keep it off notches.
function Theme.screen(name: string, order: number?): ScreenGui
	local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name, gui.ResetOnSpawn, gui.DisplayOrder = name, false, order or 0
	gui.ZIndexBehavior, gui.ScreenInsets = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling, Enum.ScreenInsets.CoreUISafeInsets
	local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera or workspace:WaitForChild("Camera")
	local function fit()
		local v = cam.ViewportSize
		scale.Scale = math.clamp(math.min(v.X / 1280, v.Y / 720), 0.6, 1.4)
	end
	fit()
	cam:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(fit)
	scale.Parent = gui
	gui.Parent = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
	return gui
end
```

### Toast.luau (Short notifications: earned coins, not enough cash, round started, unlocked.)
```luau
-- Toast: short stacked notifications that pop in at the top and shrink away ("+50 coins", "Not enough cash!").
local toastList: Frame? = nil
local function toast(gui: ScreenGui, text: string, color: Color3?, seconds: number?)
	if not toastList then
		local list = Instance.new("Frame")
		list.Size, list.AnchorPoint = UDim2.fromOffset(420, 200), Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
		list.Position, list.BackgroundTransparency = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 70), 1
		local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
		layout.Padding, layout.HorizontalAlignment = UDim.new(0, 8), Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
		layout.Parent = list
		list.Parent = gui
		toastList = list
	end
	local list = toastList :: Frame
	if #list:GetChildren() > 3 then return end -- 3 visible max: drop spam instead of stacking forever
	local f = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	f.Size, f.BackgroundColor3, f.ZIndex, f.Text = UDim2.fromOffset(380, 48), color or Theme.Ink, 20, text
	f.Font, f.TextScaled, f.TextColor3 = Theme.Body, true, Theme.Cream
	Theme.corner(f, 24)
	Theme.stroke(f, 3, Theme.Ink, true)
	Theme.stroke(f, 2.5)
	local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding")
	pad.PaddingTop, pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 8), UDim.new(0, 8)
	pad.Parent = f
	f.Parent = list
	Theme.pop(f, 0.25)
	task.delay(seconds or 2.2, function()
		local s = f:FindFirstChild("Juice") :: UIScale?
		if s then Theme.tween(s, 0.2, { Scale = 0 }).Completed:Wait() end
		f:Destroy()
	end)
end
```

```luau
-- RewardPopup: big centre celebration (level up, chest, unlock, win) with spinning burst rays, overshoot pop, auto close.
local function rewardPopup(gui: ScreenGui, title: string, amount: string, color: Color3?)
	local c = color or Theme.Primary
	local root = Instance.new("Frame")
	root.Size, root.AnchorPoint, root.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(420, 420), Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.45)
	root.BackgroundTransparency, root.ZIndex = 1, 30
	root.Parent = gui
	local rays = Instance.new("Frame") -- 6 thin bars crossing at the centre = 12 rays, spun slowly
	rays.Size, rays.AnchorPoint, rays.Position = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	rays.BackgroundTransparency, rays.ZIndex = 1, 30
	rays.Parent = root
	for i = 0, 5 do
		local r = Instance.new("Frame")
		r.Size, r.AnchorPoint, r.Position = UDim2.new(0, 34, 1, 0), Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
		r.Rotation, r.BackgroundColor3, r.BackgroundTransparency, r.ZIndex = i * 30, c, 0.55, 30
		local g = Instance.new("UIGradient") -- fade both ends so the rays read as light, not sticks
		g.Rotation = 90
		g.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) })
		g.Parent = r
		r.Parent = rays
	end
	local card = Instance.new("Frame")
	card.Size, card.AnchorPoint, card.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(300, 170), Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	card.BackgroundColor3, card.ZIndex = c, 31
	Theme.corner(card, 22)
	Theme.gradient(card, c)
	Theme.stroke(card, 5, nil, true)
	card.Parent = root
	for i, t in { title, amount } do
		local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		l.Size, l.Position = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0.42, 0), UDim2.new(0, 12, if i == 1 then 0.08 else 0.5, 0)
		l.BackgroundTransparency, l.Text, l.ZIndex = 1, t, 32
		l.Font, l.TextScaled, l.TextColor3 = Theme.Header, true, Theme.Cream
		Theme.stroke(l, if i == 1 then 3 else 4)
		l.Parent = card
	end
	Theme.pop(root, 0.45)
	local spin = true
	task.spawn(function()
		while spin and rays.Parent do
			rays.Rotation += 1.2
			task.wait()
		end
	end)
	task.delay(2.5, function()
		local s = root:FindFirstChild("Juice") :: UIScale?
		if s then Theme.tween(s, 0.2, { Scale = 0 }).Completed:Wait() end
		spin = false
		root:Destroy()
	end)
end
```

```luau
-- ===== income tracking =====
local samples = {}
local lastCash: number? = nil
local incomeShown = false
local lastAck = 0

local function ack()
	if ackRemote and ackRemote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
		ackRemote:FireServer("income")
	end
end

local function refreshIncome()
	local now = os.clock()
	local total = 0
	local kept = {}
	for _, smp in samples do
		if now - smp[1] <= 5 then
			total += smp[2]
			table.insert(kept, smp)
		end
	end
	samples = kept
	local perSec = total / 5
	incomeLabel.Text = "+$" .. NumberFormat.short(math.floor(perSec + 0.5)) .. "/s"
	if perSec > 0 and not incomeLabel.Visible then
		incomeLabel.Visible = true
	end
	if incomeLabel.Visible and (not incomeShown or now - lastAck >= 5) then
		incomeShown = true
		lastAck = now
		ack()
	end
end

-- goal bar
local goalName = ""
local goalCost = 0
local cashValue: number = 0

local function refreshGoal()
	if goalCost > 0 then
		goalLabel.Text = string.format("Next: %s ($%s)", goalName, NumberFormat.short(goalCost))
		local frac = math.clamp(cashValue / goalCost, 0, 1)
		tween(barFill, 0.2, { Size = UDim2.fromScale(frac, 1) })
		barFill.BackgroundColor3 = if frac >= 1 then UiTheme.good else UiTheme.accent
	else
		goalLabel.Text = "Next goal"
		barFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
	end
end

task.spawn(function()
	local stats = player:WaitForChild("leaderstats", 30)
	local cash = stats and stats:WaitForChild("Cash", 30)
	if not cash then
		warn("JuiceFx: Cash leaderstat not found")
		return
	end
	lastCash = cash.Value
	cashValue = cash.Value
	cash.Changed:Connect(function(v)
		if type(v) ~= "number" then
			return
		end
		if lastCash and v > lastCash then
			table.insert(samples, { os.clock(), v - lastCash })
		end
		lastCash = v
		cashValue = v
		refreshGoal()
		refreshIncome()
	end)
	refreshGoal()
	while screen.Parent do
		refreshIncome()
		task.wait(1)
	end
end)

-- ===== remote events =====
local function field(data, key: string)
	if type(data) == "table" then
		return data[key]
	end
	return nil
end

local function toPosition(data): Vector3?
	local p = field(data, "position")
	if typeof(p) == "Vector3" then
		return p
	end
	local pad = field(data, "pad")
	if typeof(pad) == "Instance" and pad:IsA("BasePart") then
		return pad.Position
	end
	return nil
end

local function onFx(kind, data)
	if type(kind) ~= "string" then
		return
	end
	if kind == "buy" then
		local name = field(data, "name")
		if name == nil and type(data) == "string" then
			name = data
		end
		safe(GameAssets.play, "Buy")
		local pos = toPosition(data)
		if pos then
			safe(GameAssets.burst, pos, UiTheme.accent, 24)
		end
		safe(GameAssets.shake, 0.3, 0.2)
		toast("Unlocked: " .. tostring(name or "Upgrade") .. "!", UiTheme.good)
	elseif kind == "poor" then
		local need = field(data, "need")
		if type(data) == "number" then
			need = data
		end
		if type(need) ~= "number" then
			local cost = field(data, "cost")
			need = if type(cost) == "number" then math.max(0, cost - cashValue) else 0
		end
		safe(GameAssets.play, "Error")
		toast("Need $" .. NumberFormat.short(need) .. " more", UiTheme.bad)
	elseif kind == "ore" then
		local value = field(data, "value")
		if type(data) == "number" then
			value = data
		end
		safe(GameAssets.play, "Win")
		rewardPopup("GOLD ORE!", "$" .. NumberFormat.short(value or 0) .. " per cube", UiTheme.accent)
		safe(GameAssets.shake, 0.5, 0.3)
	elseif kind == "rebirth" then
		safe(GameAssets.play, "Boom")
		task.delay(0.4, function()
			safe(GameAssets.play, "Win")
		end)
		safe(GameAssets.shake, 1, 0.6)
		whiteFlash()
	elseif kind == "goal" then
		local name = field(data, "name")
		local cost = field(data, "cost")
		goalName = tostring(name or "Upgrade")
		goalCost = if type(cost) == "number" then cost else 0
		refreshGoal()
	end
end

if fxRemote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
	fxRemote.OnClientEvent:Connect(onFx)
else
	warn("JuiceFx: remote is not a RemoteEvent")
end
```
